title: Pause and settings menus use plain labels without emoji
summary: Decorative arrow glyphs are removed from Pause, Settings and the development-log Play link, leaving restrained text-only menu labels and selections.
details: Inspected desktop Pause and 390-pixel Settings captures: Resume and the four settings sections render as plain text, with no emoji or arrow decoration.

The host menu gate passed Settings from both Main Menu and Pause across four viewport layouts, with 44-pixel targets, saved controls/map/crash/camera preferences, transparent HUD controls, real driving, and Resume behavior.
limitation: Host verification passed; public deployment and verification are pending.
caption: Pause menu with plain text labels and no decorative emoji or arrows
